newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to look at insurance consumer protection.
newsitem.headline: Japan to look at insurance consumer protection.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry (MOF) will set up an insurance council under Finance Minister Wataru Kubo to discuss how to insure policy holders in the event of insurance firm failures, a MOF official said on Wednesday.
The date for the first meeting had not yet been set, he said.

The council decided it was too early to discuss the issue of life and non-life insurance subsidiaries entering each others' business areas as such moves only started on October 1. The topic of whether or not to allow banks and other industries to sell insurance may be discussed, he added.
